rawExtraction.eligibility_details: Eligible dogs will have undergone histopathologic evaluation of their tumor. Dogs should weigh more than 10 kg (22 lbs) to be eligible and be older than 1 year of age. Preoperative medical records, radiographs, ultrasounds, complete blood counts, serum chemistries and urinalyses required. Owner must sign informed consent form. Participating dogs must: have owner willing to comply with all study procedures and available for duration of study; have no concurrent kidney, liver or heart disease or blood clotting problems; have no heart-based tumors.
rawExtraction.eligibility_summary: Dogs over 10 kg (22 lbs) and older than 1 year with histopathologically confirmed hemangiosarcoma (visceral and/or cutaneous) with no concurrent kidney, liver, heart disease, or blood clotting problems.
